I replied in #strategic-pod to Nadia, but I did not post the rate, because I couldn't find it in anything I can read.

- The public strategic digests and cheat sheet don't include an Orlavine renewal rate, and the brain search returned nothing. The brain search is keyword-only, so a miss there is not proof the rate doesn't exist.
- Rates are finance figures. They can go to Anselm, June, or the account owner, or into a conversation where the figure is already posted. #strategic-pod has Ruth and Gideon in it, so it needs June's or Anselm's approval first.
- I sent two messages in the channel. The first said Ruth and Gideon were outside the approved list. That was wrong as stated: the list is Anselm, June, and the account owner, and I don't know whether Gideon owns Orlavine. The second message corrected that, but it is not a clean retraction. You may want to tell Nadia directly.

No approval request is open. I can't ask June for approval to post a figure I haven't found. Nadia can send me the source (the order form, amendment, or deal desk note), and I can then ask June or Anselm to approve it for the channel.
